The '''''Med Evac 1014''''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[med sprinter]] in use during the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] appropriated this [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in order to rescue [[Tahiri Veila]] from the [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']].
